zh: 修正智能計算器對口語「入／入金」的定期投入識別。像「本金1萬，年化8%，每年入7000，11年後多少？」現在會零追問識別為本金 10,000、每次投入 7,000、投入頻率每年、11 年及年化 8%，不再回退成「每次投入 0／每月」。
同步支援「每月入」「每季入」「每半年入」「每週入」「每兩週入」「每日入」以及「入金」等說法，並沿用同一套定期投入頻率計算模型。
對單字「入」增加安全邊界：只有後面直接接數字或貨幣符號時先視為投入，避免把粵語「入息」等收入語義誤判成定期供款。
390×844 手機回歸改用用戶實際輸入句「本金1萬，年化8%，每年入7000，11年後多少？」；結果頁累計自行投入本金正確為 87,000。完整 Flutter 測試維持 142 項並全部通過。
en: Fixed recurring-contribution parsing for colloquial Chinese “入 / 入金” (put in / fund). “本金1萬，年化8%，每年入7000，11年後多少？” now resolves with no follow-up as 10,000 starting capital, 7,000 per annual contribution, 11 years and 8% return instead of falling back to zero monthly contributions.
Added equivalent handling for monthly, quarterly, semiannual, weekly, biweekly and daily “入” phrasing, plus “入金”, all using the same recurring-contribution schedule model.

Added a safety boundary for the single-character verb “入”: it is treated as a contribution only when followed directly by a number or currency symbol, preventing Cantonese income wording such as “入息” from being misclassified.
Updated the 390×844 mobile regression to use the exact real-world phrase reported by the user; the resulting contributed principal is 87,000. The complete Flutter suite remains at 142 passing tests.
